text: Lead 2026-10-05: privacy rule wins. Withheld inputs stay nameless (InputEntry: a file name may identify a participant, and a hashed guessable name can be reversed). Withheld entries may repeat, one per input with those bytes. DuplicateInput applies only to stored inputs, which are already keyed by inputs/<sha>/<name>. Identical bytes are interchangeable, so a repeated withheld entry loses nothing.
